title: Personal Training Packages: the habitual late-cancellation surcharge threshold
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the basis on which an additional habitual-cancellation surcharge begins to apply on top of the ordinary late-cancellation charge.

## Rule
Once a member accumulates the tier's own habitual-cancellation threshold or more late cancellations within the tier's own trailing counting window, each further late cancellation within that window additionally incurs the tier's own habitual surcharge amount on top of the ordinary late-cancellation charge.

~~counting every late-cancellation ledger entry recorded for that member, across every package the member holds, toward the same window~~ This clause is no longer in force for which late cancellations are pooled together when counting toward the threshold; the current basis for how the count is administered is stated in the per-package-habitual-late-cancellation-surcharge document for this product.

## Points of judgement
The habitual surcharge is never charged on its own; it is always added on top of the ordinary late-cancellation charge once the running count within the trailing window reaches or exceeds the tier's own threshold. Below that threshold, no habitual surcharge is added and only the ordinary late-cancellation charge applies. The counting window is a trailing period measured backward from the moment each new late cancellation is being logged, so a late cancellation that falls outside the window no longer contributes to the running count.
